description: Create up to 50 items in one call. Set `collections` on an item to file it into collections as it is created, which is cheaper than creating it and moving it afterwards. Notes and attachments are created by setting parentItem. To attach a file from disk use zotero_attach_file instead, which handles the whole attachment protocol. Check the returned `failures` array: Zotero validates each item independently, so some can succeed while others fail.

groupId.description: Group library ID. Omit for the personal library ("My Library"), which is what almost every request wants. Group IDs come from zotero_list_libraries.

items.description: Items to create, at most 50 per call.
Zotero item JSON. Any field valid for the itemType may be included alongside the documented ones.

collections.description: Collection keys the new item should be filed into. This is how an item lands in a collection at creation time.

firstName.description: Given name; pair with lastName for a two-field name.

name.description: Single-field name, for institutions. Use instead of firstName/lastName.

itemType.description: Zotero item type, e.g. "journalArticle", "book", "bookSection", "thesis", "preprint", "conferencePaper", "report", "note", "attachment". Use zotero_get_item_type_fields to check which fields a type accepts.

parentItem.description: Parent item key, for notes and attachments.

tags.description: Tags to attach. type 1 marks an automatic tag; omit type for a manual one.

name: zotero_create_items
title: Create items
